name: Lactase
indication_description:
Prevention of symptoms of lactose intolerance-
  • Infantile colic
  • Abdominal pain
  • Bloating
  • Flatulence
  • Diarrhea
  • Borborygmi
pharmacology_description: Lactase is an enzyme that helps to prevent symptoms of lactose intolerance by breaking down milk sugar (lactose) to produce glucose and galactose via hydrolysis and making dairy foods easier to digest.
dosage_description:
Adult: 1 tablet (300 mg) with dairy food. If needed dose can be adjusted up to 2 tablets (600 mg) at a time.

Infants: Add lactase enzyme to breast milk or formula in the following directions-

Breast Milk:
  • Express a few tablespoons (2-3 tablespoons) of breast milk into sterilized container
  • Add 4 drops of lactase paediatric drops
  • Give mixture to infant on a spoon or oral syringe before initiating breastfeeding
  • Breast feed as normal
Formula:
  • Add 4 drops of lactase paediatric drops to warm (not hot) formula
  • Wait 30 minutes, shaking formula occasionally
Making formula in advance:
  • Add 2 drops of lactase paediatric drops to warm formula
  • Store in refrigerator for minimum 4 hours
  • Feed Infant as normal
  • Use within 12 hour
  • Discard any unused formula
Children: Effective & safe in children above 4 years of age.
interaction_description: No information for lactase interactions has been found yet.
contraindications_description: This drug is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to lactase or any other components of the product.
side_effects_description: There are no major side effects reported. The very few side effects may include rash, difficulty in breathing, tightness in chest etc.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: It is unknown if lactase may cause harm to the fetus. Therefore, lactase should be given during pregnancy only when clearly needed. It is unknown if lactase is excreted in breast milk. Thus, lactase should be given during lactation only when clearly needed.
storage_conditions_description: Keep below 30°C temperature, away from light & moisture. Keep out of the reach of children.
